'''2009 World Championship''' was the 14th Star Wars CCG World Championship, run by the [[Players Committee]] at the Clarion Hotel in Princeton, New Jersey, on 8–11 October 2009.<ref name="forum" /><ref name="awards">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards and Hall of Fame], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016161923/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/community-awards.html Internet Archive]</ref> The constructed pool was [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.1]]. 53 players took part.<ref name="wp" /> [[Brian Hunter]] defeated [[Justin Desai]] in the final, playing No Money, No Parts, No Deal! and Watch Your Step on Day 3; it was Desai's second runner-up finish after 2007.<ref name="awards" /><ref name="f75427-1300387">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1300387#p1300387 Post by Yoshi], "SWCCG Worlds Day 3 Standings History", forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152200/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t75427.html#p1300387 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee published the Day 2, Day 3 and Team Tournament lists; no Day 1 lists were published.<ref name="dl2009" />

=== Top 8 bracket ===

A 2020 forum post quoting an earlier player compilation gives this Day 3 bracket (seeds in brackets).<ref name="f75427-1300387" /> It names Mike Gemme where the Day 3 sheets have Mike Gerome.

* Quarterfinals: (8) [[Justin Desai]] def. (1) [[Jonny Chu]]; (2) [[Brian Hunter]] def. (7) [[Matt Sokol]]; (3) [[Jan Westergard]] def. (6) [[Joe Olson]]; (5) [[Mike Gemme|Mike Gemme]] def. (4) [[Aaron Nelson]]
* Semifinals: Justin Desai def. Mike Gemme; Brian Hunter def. Jan Westergard
* Final: Brian Hunter def. Justin Desai

Remaining Day 3 Xerox sheets are in [[:File:2009 Worlds Day 3.pdf]]. Pages 11–14 are Joe Olson's typed Light and Dark lists.
